notes: Primary data came from the site's own JSON endpoints, not the DOM: /media/data/datasets.json, models.json, providers.json, evaluations.json, and the per-version rollups /media/data/leaderboard/v1.json, v2.json, v3.json. evaluations.json (889 rows) is the superset; the v1/v2/v3 files are pre-joined subsets of it and were saved for completeness.

The Community Leaderboard tab (https://arcprize.org/leaderboard/community) has no JSON endpoint. Its 22 rows were taken from the server-rendered React Server Component flight payload (self.__next_f), which carries unrounded numbers, rather than from the rendered table.

Do not read community costs off the rendered page: the site formats them with locale separators, so a cost of 2986.04 renders as '$2.986' and 18000 renders as '$18.000'. The values in raw.json / normalized.json are the underlying numbers.

cost_usd carries ARC's costPerTask field and is present for ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2 rows. ARC-AGI-3 rows and all community rows have no per-task cost in the source; they carry a total run cost under the separate field cost_usd_total. The two are not interchangeable and were kept apart rather than merged.

score is expressed as a percentage (0-100). Verified rows come from ARC as 0-1 fractions and were multiplied by 100; community rows are already percentages in the source. metric is set to accuracy_pct throughout.
rank is computed, not published: rows are ordered by score descending within each (leaderboard, benchmark, benchmark_set) group, with ties sharing a rank.
20 evaluation rows carry display:false in evaluations.json and are hidden on the site. They are excluded from normalized.json but retained verbatim in raw.json.
context_window is not published anywhere on the ARC Prize leaderboard, so the field is omitted from every record rather than filled in.
datasets.json also declares v1_Private_Eval and v3_Public_Demo. v1_Private_Eval has zero evaluations in the source; v3_Public_Demo appears only via community submissions.
System type is preserved as model_type (Base LLM, CoT, CoT + Synthesis, Refinement, Custom). Kaggle/competition entries are identifiable by provider 'ARC Prize 2024' / 'ARC Prize 2025'.
results_url is relative to https://arcprize.org as published by the site.
changes_vs_20260902: Row count unchanged: 891 (869 verified + 22 community), same as 20260902. All 6 active dataset splits returned identical counts (217/196/219/207/3/27).
No models were added to or removed from the leaderboard since 20260902.

One data-quality fix on ARC's side: the Anthropic ARC-AGI-1/ARC-AGI-2 model that had model=true (a literal JSON boolean, a site bug) on 20260902 now has model='Claude Opus 4.6 (120K, Max)'. Same score/cost/rank/date across all 4 of its benchmark rows, confirming it's the same entry with a corrected display name, not a new model.

19 rows show score deltas of exactly 0.01 (e.g. 96.63 -> 96.62) with a few consequent 1-place rank shifts (e.g. rank 23->24). These look like floating-point rounding-boundary artifacts between this scrape's rounding and the prior one rather than real leaderboard movement; flagging rather than silently normalizing away.
'Tiny Recursion Model (TRM)' (Bespoke) has model_type='' in this scrape vs null on 20260902 across its 3 rows -- cosmetic, no model_type value either way.
Muse Spark 1.3 and Gemini 3.8 Flash: absent from both the 20260902 and 20260903 scrapes. Not on ARC Prize's verified or community leaderboards under any name variant searched.
